decisions.reason: The quote directly states that neuronal ceroid lipofuscinoses 'cause blindness' as one of its clinical phenotypes. The grammatical subject is the disease and blindness is explicitly listed as a phenotype it causes.
The quote directly states that neuronal ceroid lipofuscinoses 'cause...seizures' as one of its clinical phenotypes. Seizures is explicitly listed in the disease description.

The quote states that neuronal ceroid lipofuscinoses cause 'loss of motor function'. The candidate uses 'motor decline' which is a reasonably synonymous description of loss of motor function. The grammatical subject is the disease and this is a phenotype it causes.

The quote states that neuronal ceroid lipofuscinoses cause loss of 'cognitive ability'. The candidate uses 'cognitive impairment' which is a synonymous descriptor for loss of cognitive ability. The grammatical subject is the disease and this is a phenotype it causes.
